scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.gen:api-types: uv run --directory apps/api python -m scripts.export_openapi && pnpm --filter web gen:api-types
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web format:check && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.check:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check . && uv run --directory apps/api mypy && uv run --directory apps/api pytest
